intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded fees and 2023 placements from our database opened in {{year}}.
GLS University vs Som Lalit College for commerce is a same-city comparison with a wide fee gap. Som Lalit has the higher recorded 2023 packages. GLS has higher recorded year tuition on this page.

sections.heading: GLS University vs Som Lalit College for B.Com: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Som Lalit College if recorded year tuition is your first filter, at ₹35,000, and you want the higher recorded 2023 figures, at an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh.

Choose GLS University if you want a university campus and have budgeted for recorded tuition from about ₹1.07 lakh to ₹1.77 lakh a year, depending on the programme. Its 2023 average is ₹4 lakh, with a highest of ₹8 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: GLS University's recorded B.Com tuition on this page is ₹1.07 lakh, ₹1.43 lakh and ₹1.77 lakh a year, depending on the programme. Treat these as year fees, not confirmed programme totals.
Som Lalit College has recorded tuition of ₹35,000 a year. That is much lower than GLS in our records. Confirm both official circulars for the current admission year and any add-on charges.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

Som Lalit's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹5 lakh and a highest package of ₹10 lakh. GLS University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Many Ahmedabad B.Com admissions are based on Class 12 marks.
Read the current official admissions page of each institute for eligibility, subject combinations and any university-level process.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. GLS University and Som Lalit College are separate campuses in the same city.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, visit both and compare the official fee, because the recorded year tuition gap is large.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On recorded 2023 packages and year tuition, Som Lalit College is the lower-fee, higher-package side on this page.
GLS University may still suit you if you want a university campus and a specific programme whose official fee you have checked.
Confirm both official circulars before you treat ₹35,000 or ₹1.77 lakh as your actual cost.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, GLS University or Som Lalit College, for B.Com?
faqs.answer: Som Lalit has a lower recorded year tuition, at ₹35,000, and higher 2023 figures, at a ₹5 lakh average and a ₹10 lakh highest package. GLS recorded tuition is about ₹1.07 lakh to ₹1.77 lakh a year, with 2023 figures of a ₹4 lakh average and an ₹8 lakh highest package.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Com fees?
faqs.answer: GLS University's recorded tuition is ₹1.07 lakh, ₹1.43 lakh and ₹1.77 lakh a year, depending on the programme. Som Lalit College has recorded tuition of ₹35,000 a year. Confirm official circulars.

faqs.question: Do these institutes have an entrance exam for B.Com?
faqs.answer: No exam is listed for either side in our records on this page. Check each official admissions page.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: Both have recorded 2023 figures. Som Lalit shows an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh. GLS shows an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Ahmedabad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses.
